notes.title: Playism Publisher Sale starts now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/5063e9f11e0d7186674f4118450f0768365be75f.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the release of Gensokyo Night Festival and the soundtrack of Touhou Luna Nights on October 14th, as well as the release of the English update and soundtrack of Lost Technology on the 15th, we are happy to announce the Playism Publisher Sale!  
＊The soundract of Touhou Luna Nights is currently 10% off!

As it is a Publisher Sale, the discount rate is higher than the usual sales!

YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY- is 80% off!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/774811/YUMENIKKI_DREAM_DIARY/

Ace of Seafood is 70% off! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/450500/Ace_of_Seafood/

Discover the full version of Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden. A mini scenario has been added in April!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/363980/Forget_Me_Not_My_Organic_Garden/

Take a look at the other titles:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Playism/list/51161

The sale will only last one week, please check it out!

notes.title: Rime Berta Joins the Holiday Sales!
notes.content:
The holiday sales have kicked off on Steam, and we have added Rime Berta to the festive activities! 

[quote]Command an army of puppets in this Japanese SRPG as you hunt for a relic said to grant any wish. Livia's village is dying, and all that can help them is an ancient relic situated somewhere within a mystical tower.
[/quote]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/312600/capsule_616x353.jpg?t=1488956399[/img]

[h1]Grab Rime Berta now for 75% off![/h1]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/312600/Rime_Berta/

notes.title: Rime Berta on Sale and New Bundle Info!
notes.content:
Hi All!

We hope you are having fantastic holidays! 

The Steam Winter Sales have started, and Rime Berta has joined the sales, you can now get it for 75% off! 

You can find all the Playism titles that are on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?snr=1_4_4__12&term=agm+playism]sale here[/url], or [url=http://playism-games.com/article/steam-winter-sales-2016-2017]listed on our blog![/url]

[h1]We have also just added some exciting bundles![/h1] 
Rime Berta, Unholy Heights, Magic Potion Explorer and  Healer Only Lives Twice are now part of the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2352/]Playism Strategy Bundle![/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2352/] 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7338640/410397b27e896ad4ee8f4d4ee52b64a63cd53144.jpg[/img][img][/img]
[/url] 

[quote]The Playism Strategy Bundle brings together all the great Strategy games that Playism has to offer. If you are looking for your set of games and love a challenge, then check out this bundle! [/quote]

[h1]The bundle includes: [/h1]
Rime Berta
http://store.steampowered.com/app/312600/
Unholy Heights
http://store.steampowered.com/app/249330/
Magic Potion Explorer
http://store.steampowered.com/app/442890/
Healer Only Lives Twice
http://store.steampowered.com/app/453300/

[h1]For a full list of our new bundles, make sure you check out our blog post:[/h1]
[url=http://playism-games.com/article/playisms-new-bundles]Playism's New Bundles! on the Playism Blog[/url]

[h1]For more information and news, be sure to join the Playism Group! [/h1]
